title: Two more games in the showcase
summary:
Three community apps joined the project lists, while outdated listings and a tutorial link got some attention.

AIStorium joined the Games list with interactive stories, images, and audio generated through Pollinations. AI Word Search joined with personalized word puzzles that can be printed or shared.

Prompt Explorer joined the Learn list, combining AI-art prompt discovery with Pollinations image generation. The Open Web UI tutorial link now points to the current guide.

Outdated listings were removed, Anime Character Generator now points to its working app page, and the README and project tables were brought into line.
